actions.action: Reapply issue #52 item 3 as form (iii), DEC-033: computed.next_action.requires names, per fixture and in that fixture's own function, the observed.* and asserted.* keys the ACTION consumes; computed.freshness stays what the DERIVATION consumed and no sealed field moves. build.py reads the rule from the schema as it does for item 2.
prerequisites: NS-034 merged as WP-033 (PR for issue #55)
DEC-026 disposition 5: per action, no inherited global default, each dependency names an existing key, each fixture carries positive and negative tests for its own edge

DEC-033: requires may name asserted.* as well as observed.* keys - a recorded departure from the letter of DEC-026 disposition 5 ('an existing observation'), which the operator is asked to confirm or refuse on issue #52 before this action starts; freshness is not rescoped to requires
Schema amendment to 3.0.0: computed.next_action is additionalProperties false, so requires is a backward-incompatible addition that regenerates all nine fixtures, frozen HTML and manifests
evidence_required: No requires value is assigned in build.py's base() or otherwise inherited; a test reads each fixture function's source and requires an explicit assignment in every function whose next_action is not null
Every fixture carries a positive test naming its own expected edge and a negative test proving build.py --check refuses an edge naming a key that does not exist, and refuses an empty edge
A test diffs every fixture's resume_decision, computed.freshness, stop_conditions and every oracle.yaml against the pre-change tree and requires them byte-identical - the additive-only guard
Eight identical edges on the eight fixtures that share NS-030 are expected and recorded as such: the same action consumes the same inputs; what is forbidden is inheritance, not agreement
stop_conditions: One value is assigned in base() or reaches a fixture whose function did not assign it - that is exactly what #57 reverted
Any sealed field - resume_decision, computed.freshness, stop_conditions, any oracle - differs byte-for-byte from the pre-change tree
Oracles are edited by the author who wrote the fixtures
actions.fallback: Leave item 3 open and record that the artifact still cannot say what an action consumes.
